parlays.title: Daily Double
parlays.cutoff: A fun ticket is not re-entered. It stands or falls as posted.
parlays.edge: Desk-researched fun ticket. No validated win probability or positive-EV claim.
parlays.why: Pittsburgh is averaging 4.8 a carry and Philly is missing Zack Baun. I’ll take the extra point and a half with that matchup. Denver has scored at least 26 in three straight, and Fernando Mendoza took six sacks in his first start. I like Denver by six with Jaylen Waddle back.
risks: DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley are back to full practice. Joe Milton can run against pressure, and Nick Herbig is questionable. There is a chance of rain with light wind.
Mendoza was 11 of 13 before halftime last week and can move the sticks with his legs. Bowers might play and provide a reliable outlet. A division game can stay close.
